steps.content: A few steps more, and a ring of shadows blocks her path. Their forms are distorted, but the faces are horribly clear. She knows them. They stare back from the ghostly pages of the BR-005 casualty files.

steps.speaker: Victims
steps.content: The kind-hearted lady of the Campbell family, the benevolent lady of the Campbells, the all-powerful Lady Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Victims
steps.content: Why did you not help us, why did you not save us... why did you do nothing at all?

steps.speaker: Victims
steps.content: No. Your kindness, your conscience, your goodwill... all of it is a lie...

steps.speaker: Victims
steps.content: You stood by, watching us die with open eyes... because you are even more hypocritical than your kin! Ptui!
The weeping, cursing souls cling to her as she struggles to break free, yet a deeper despair has already seeped into the very air, a prison with no walls.
